title: Safe Deposit Boxes: waitlist offers, the offer hold period and starting the lease
content:
## Scope

This policy covers what happens to a waitlisted reservation in the Safe Deposit Boxes line: the order in which boxes are offered, how long an offered box is held, what acceptance does, and how a reservation ends without a lease.

## Policy clause

1. **Priority.** Waitlisted customers are offered boxes in order of reservation date, earliest reservation first. No customer is offered a box ahead of an earlier reservation for the same size and branch.
2. **Offer.** When a box of the reserved size becomes free at the branch, it is offered to the waitlisted customer next in priority. The offer date and the number of the box offered are recorded on the reservation.
3. **Hold period.** An offered box is held for the customer only within 10 calendar days after the offer. Calendar days are counted with the day after the offer date as day 1. The customer may accept while the current date is on or before the offer date plus 10 calendar days; after that the reservation lapses. The offer date is taken from the bank's record of that reservation.
4. **Acceptance.** On acceptance the lease is signed by the lessee, the keys for the box size are issued, the key deposit is charged as a service fee, and the first year's rent is charged on the lease start date. The rental becomes active, the box number engraved on the box door is recorded, and the rent due date for the first year is the lease start date.
5. **Ending without a lease.** A reservation ends, closed without a lease, when the customer cancels it, or when an offered box is not accepted within the hold period.

## Values by box size

| Official box size | Offer hold period | Order of offers |
|---|---|---|
| 3x5 Safe Deposit Box | 10 calendar days | Reservation date, earliest first |
| 3x10 Safe Deposit Box | 10 calendar days | Reservation date, earliest first |
| 5x10 Safe Deposit Box | 10 calendar days | Reservation date, earliest first |
| 10x10 Safe Deposit Box | 10 calendar days | Reservation date, earliest first |
| 10x15 Safe Deposit Box | 10 calendar days | Reservation date, earliest first |
| 10x20 Safe Deposit Box | 10 calendar days | Reservation date, earliest first |

## Hold period: boundary cases

Hypothetical offer made on 5 March.

| Date | Day of the hold count | Position |
|---|---|---|
| 5 March | Offer date, not counted | Held |
| 6 March | Day 1 | Held |
| 15 March | Day 10, the offer date plus 10 calendar days | Held; the last day acceptance is possible |
| 16 March | After day 10 | The reservation has lapsed |

## Priority: hypothetical case

Two customers have reservations for a 5x10 box at the same branch, one dated 9 January and one dated 3 February. When a 5x10 box becomes free there, it is offered first to the customer whose reservation is dated 9 January.

## Basis Q&A

**Is the offer date itself day 1?** No. Day 1 is the day after the offer date.

**Can a customer accept on the tenth day after the offer?** Yes. Acceptance is possible while the current date is on or before the offer date plus 10 calendar days, so the boundary day is included.

**What is charged when the customer accepts?** The key deposit, as a service fee, and the first year's rent, on the lease start date.

**Can a later reservation for the same size and branch be offered the box first?** No. A box is never offered ahead of an earlier reservation for the same size and branch.
